comparison_invalid_reasons.action: No further A20 stage, no successful-subset comparison; retain all raw observations.

limitations: No binaries, tests, RPCs, or SSH commands are executed by this publisher.
Complete preservation covers rows the drivers actually recorded; calls lost before any report write cannot be reconstructed.
Hash bindings are evidence integrity checks, not signatures or independent proof that a producer was honest.
A20-only failure invalidates the comparison permanently; later A26-only coverage cannot repair it.
Same-A26 fairness slots and single-B soak do not supply a baseline performance comparison.
Orderly EOF shutdown, observed descendant exit, original-job recovery, and socket cleanup remain separate outcomes.
Sampled process resources are lower bounds and can include errors; retained timelines do not prove exhaustive process containment.
Recovery canaries do not test host reboot, physical power loss, WAN partition, or all future loads.

method.bindings: Actual received report, receipt, log and stage-artifact hashes are checked. Source/helper/runtime identities are bound through frozen input manifests and the supplied independent qualification receipt.
method.candidate_validation: Only the frozen plan's required candidate checks are covered. This verdict does not assert full SIGKILL cleanup or removal of socket residue.
method.controller_cpu: Sum of recorded same-controller /proc stat CPU deltas divided by all retained calls; missing coverage makes the aggregate null.
method.failures: All rows and recorded sampling errors remain in the sanitized report. Raw report verdict and each version verdict are separate.
method.latency: Nearest-rank quantiles over all retained individual calls, including failures. Missing/invalid latencies make quantiles null rather than selecting a subset.
method.missing_evidence: Not run, incomplete, false and null are kept distinct; a single-B run has no baseline comparison.
method.resources: Sampled local controller/process-tree lifetime peaks; not per-cell or remote-host totals. Tree CPU and peaks are lower bounds. Descendant counts do not identify SSH executables.
method.slot_identity: A/B denote scheduling slots. Their runtime roles and exact binary hashes come from each frozen stage spec.
method.structural_complete: Dimensions and required record presence are checked independently of successful outcomes; a complete failed round stays complete.
method.throughput: Retained calls or successful calls divided by sum of full cell elapsed seconds; never an average of rates.

production_runtime_changed_field_scope: The supplied frozen runner declares no production service mutation; this publisher itself only reads inputs and creates its fresh output directory.

publication_review_index.role: Readable index only; the complete original summary remains authoritative.

qualification_binding.binding_scope: Frozen full input manifests and the supplied independent qualification receipt are checked; this publisher does not rerun their verification.
